# Harriet Ainslie

## Overview

- **Age:** In her mid-fifties  <sub>[v4 c6 P11](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v4 c6 P11](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Agnes
- **Titles:** Miss Harriet  <sub>[v4 c6 P11](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0011)</sub>; Miss Ainslie  <sub>[v4 c6 P11](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Harriet is a tall, large-built, handsome woman with dark, swarthy skin and thick black hair. She has bushy black eyebrows, slaty blue eyes, and a somewhat severe, off-putting expression that is tempered by her lively voice.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P11](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0011)_

## Personality

Harriet is a resolute, opinionated, and outspoken woman who possesses a sharp, masculine intellect and a robust sense of humor. Despite her severe exterior, she is loyal, honest, and incapable of small-mindedness or malice. She holds strong, unyielding convictions, especially regarding her family and personal vows, though she eventually yields to love and reason.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P11](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0011), [v4 c6 P12](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0012), [v4 c6 P13](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0013)_

## Traits

- Outspoken and opinionated  <sub>[v4 c6 P11](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0011)</sub>
- Stubborn and determined  <sub>[v4 c21 P40](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0040)</sub>
- Intelligent and well-read  <sub>[v4 c6 P11](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0011)</sub>
- Honest and loyal  <sub>[v4 c6 P12](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0012), [v4 c21 P40](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0040)</sub>

## Abilities

- Sharp political and intellectual debate  <sub>[v4 c6 P11](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep her sister Clementine from ever marrying or leaving her  <sub>[v4 c21 P30](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0030), [v4 c22 P30](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0030)</sub>

## History

Harriet Ainslie grew up at the old Ainslie house on the hill overlooking Glen St. Agnes with her sister Clementine and her mother. In her youth, she was courted by Lionel Fairlie, but he deserted her after a quarrel and married another woman. Following the death of their mother when Clementine was twenty-five, Harriet was overcome with grief and fear of abandonment, extracting a solemn vow from Clementine that neither of them would ever marry. The sisters lived together quietly for decades. When the new minister, Mr. Ashdown, began visiting their home and eventually proposed to Clementine, Harriet fiercely insisted that Clementine abide by her oath. However, after Lionel Fairlie returned to court Harriet again and demanded her hand, Harriet realized her own desire for marriage and released Clementine from her vow. Harriet subsequently agreed to marry Lionel Fairlie.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P13](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0013), [v4 c21 P18](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0018), [v4 c21 P19](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0019), [v4 c21 P20](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0020), [v4 c21 P23](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0023), [v4 c22 P1](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0001), [v4 c22 P20](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0020)_

## Background by volume

- Her father passed away when she was thirteen years old.  <sub>[v4 c21 P18](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0018)</sub>
- She was courted in her youth by Lionel Fairlie, who jilted her after a quarrel.  <sub>[v4 c6 P13](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0013), [v4 c21 P19](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0019)</sub>
- She made a mutual oath with her sister Clementine upon their mother's Bible never to marry.  <sub>[v4 c21 P23](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0023), [v4 c22 P23](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0023)</sub>

## Quotes

> I consider it just as good to maintain an interest in matters for the duration of your life. If you fail to do so, it appears to me that little distinguishes the living from the deceased.  <sub>[v4 c21 P9](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0009)</sub>

> That promise was not requested by me. It was offered by you.  <sub>[v4 c22 P21](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0021)</sub>
